tables.name: Size
tables.description: The physical space the city occupies and the capacity of its structures, not how many people actually live there. Modifies Number of Districts; sets the Outside the City and additional location rolls.

results.name: Very Small
results.description: Structures in the city are likely able to support around 8,000 people. (-4 to number of districts roll)

results.name: Small
results.description: Structures in the city are able to support around 16,000 people. (-1 to number of districts roll)

results.name: Medium
results.description: Structures in the city are able to support around 24,000 people. (+0 to number of districts roll)

results.name: Large
results.description: Structures in the city are able to support around 32,000 people. (+2 to number of districts roll)

results.name: Very Large
results.description: Structures in the city are able to support around 40,000 people or more. (+6 to number of districts roll)
